title: Chapter 2
body:
- The server moves to Minecraft 26.2, and the Overworld border grows by 5,000 blocks
- Halloween spawn and Warzone
- Guild update: Prestige, Seasonal ELO, more level rewards and refreshed menus
- EnthusiaExpress: letters and packages for offline players, paid in Raw Gold
- New advancements across duels, reputation, mail and diaries, claimed with /rewards
- Warzone combat: a boss bar for your combat timer, and restrictions that stay if you leave mid-fight
- Donor perks: donor profiles, gift announcements, mapart shields for Devotee and item signatures for Avid

title: Warzone Rotators
body:
- The Warzone kit now rotates every week
- Voted in by the community in May

title: August update
body:
- Java 25
- A network tab list
- /daily rewards
- 100 achievements

title: Website overhaul
body:
- A new look for the website
- An interactive Market page showing every stall, its owner and its stock

title: Emergency maintenance
body:
- Fixed a homes exploit
- Fixed a duel-spectating exploit

title: Market relaunch
body:
- The Market reopens with a stall auction
- A re-bid on 10 July after server trouble

title: The Market
body:
- The Market releases, then pauses within hours over auction problems
- Every bid refunded

title: Autoclicker mod
body:
- An official Enthusia autoclicker mod by p2wn is published on Modrinth
- A rework of guild progression is announced

title: 26.2 clients
body: - Players on Minecraft 26.2 can join

title: PieCloak
body: - Common base blocks and entities are hidden at a distance, so pie-chart base hunting is less reliable

title: Death Duels
body:
- 1v1 duels to the death in the spawn arena
- Custom rules and wagers
- A loot vault for the winner

title: Nether roof
body: - Players can build and travel on the Nether roof

title: Full release
body:
- A 100k Overworld border
- The Raw Gold economy
- Guilds, reputation and bounties
- Proximity voice chat

title: Host upgrade
body: - The server moves to a host that can carry a 100k world border

- The beta updates to 1.21.11, with spears
- Guild history lookups
- A first Survival Games playtest

title: Wiki and a new address
body:
- The Enthusia wiki opens to community editing
- Enthusia.net becomes the main address

title: Bank and reputation
body:
- Raw Gold can be banked with /deposit and taken out with /withdrawl
- /baltop becomes a menu with player heads
- Gold in shulker boxes counts towards your balance
- Homes, beds and teleports rebuilt in-house
- Commendations get their first effects

title: The Prologue
body:
- Borders grow to 20k in the Overworld, 10k in the Nether and 25k in the End
- Balances and bounties reset after a major dupe
- Guild stalls open for testing
- Minecraft to Discord linking with /link

title: Final Open Beta
body:
- Commendations, the reputation system
- A rebuilt playtime system
- A 44-stall Market

title: Store
body:
- The store opens with Avid and Devotee, and no pay-to-win perks
- The Founder's Badge for early supporters

title: Guild KOTH and combat logging
body:
- Guilds can enter KOTH as teams
- Logging out in combat leaves an NPC behind
- New players get 30 minutes of protection

title: Raw Gold
body:
- The currency changes from Diamonds to Raw Gold
- First PvP arena test

title: First Open Beta
body:
- The Diary, given to every player on first join
- Market stalls, bounties and KOTH at Haunted Hill
- Guilds open to all players
